test_title: PYST 74: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct meaning of the idiom 'go the extra mile' in the sentence:

She always goes the extra mile to support her students.
solution:
**The correct answer is: Option 2) Puts in extra effort.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Go the extra mile** is an idiom that means to make an extra effort or to do more than what is expected or required. (अतिरिक्त प्रयास करना)

 
 
• **Example:** She always goes the extra mile to support her students.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Puts in extra effort**.
